The Problem Statement

Why Campus Queries Get Stuck — and Why Existing Bots Fall Short

Critical college information is fragmented across websites, PDF circulars, physical notice boards, and messaging groups. Meanwhile, administrative staff are overwhelmed by repetitive questions during admission and exam peaks.

Scattered Information

Dates, fee structures, and rules live in disconnected PDFs, notice boards, and chat groups.

Working-Hours Bottleneck

Queries wait hours or days when the administrative office is closed or flooded with calls.

Repetitive Staff Load

Office staff spend hours answering the same admission, hostel, and exam questions repeatedly.

Inconsistent Answers

Outdated circulars and informal replies lead to conflicting dates or wrong fee figures.
